originalAssets.name: VanHeadlampOptics-v1
originalAssets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production diffuse/base-color texture for the front headlight lenses of a realistic mobile Unity service-van 3D model. Create ONE original generic automotive headlamp optical interior texture, horizontal 2.1:1 aspect ratio, straight-on orthographic macro photograph, filling the entire rectangular image edge to edge with headlamp optics. Two physically convincing small clear glass projector reflectors, nuanced silver reflector bowls, fine prismatic ribs and a restrained thin white lower LED guide inside a narrow charcoal surround. Neutral studio illumination, no blown highlights, subtle blue-grey clear glass tint, crisp industrial manufacture and real optical depth. This is a UV texture, not a scene, not a screenshot or concept sheet. No car body, no background environment, no margins, no text, no logos, no orange indicator, no dramatic bloom, no cartoon, no illustrated buttons. Lens and silver optics should occupy almost the entire frame. Edge pixels should be dark charcoal so the texture fits inside a modeled rounded rectangular lamp. High-quality realistic automotive material, front-facing, no perspective.
